lines.text: Did you know? Fer is Latin for carry.
Quick quiz! Which means apart plus carry?

words.ex: The company offered her a job in London.
Many people suffer from back pain.
Prices differ greatly from one shop to another.

publish.title: Fer root: offer, suffer and differ
publish.value: Fer comes from Latin "ferre" (to carry, to bring). Words: offer, suffer and differ. offer = of + fer; suffer = suf + fer; differ = dif + fer.
